metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 평면과 삼각형 ① 표면까지의 거리
metadata.description:
앞 강의에서는 연결선과 물체의 범위를 구했습니다. 이제 그 범위에서 고른 점이 실제 표면에서 얼마나 떨어졌는지 계산합니다. 바닥을 따라가는 방향과 수직 방향을 구분하고, 같은 점으로 대입값·거리·가장 가까운 위치를 차례로 확인합니다. 이어서 세 점과 순서 있는 경계로 면의 방향을 구합니다. 표면까지 도착해도 유한한 발판 안인지는 남는 질문입니다. 그 질문을 다음 편의 삼각형 좌표로 이어갑니다. 평면과 삼각형 두 편 중 첫 번째 강의입니다.

englishMetadata.title: Game Math Part 2 · Planes and Triangles 1: Distance to a Surface
englishMetadata.description:
The previous lecture calculated connections and object bounds. Now we ask how far a selected point is from a surface. We distinguish directions along the floor from its normal, then follow the same point through equation residual, perpendicular distance and closest position. Next, three points and an ordered boundary give us the surface direction. Reaching the infinite plane still leaves the finite-platform question, which motivates triangle coordinates in the next lecture. This is the first of two lectures on planes and triangles.

Game Math PART2 course materials
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 From a bounding-box candidate to the actual surface
00:22 Distance to a floor and position inside a triangle
00:44 Observe the platform surface as a reference
01:29 Directions along the floor and perpendicular to it
01:58 Leave the floor and return to a surface
02:52 Separate a plane’s direction and position
03:38 Why can the residual double for the same floor?
04:04 Separate an equation value from actual distance
04:49 Observe position and slope separately
05:31 Terrain height and its reference
06:26 From a distance to the point we should reach
06:52 The closest point on a plane
07:32 Build a normal from the surface we observed
08:03 Construct a normal from three points
08:45 Observe a visible triangular floor marking
09:39 Follow boundary order as surface direction changes
10:12 From three points to a boundary with more vertices
10:36 Multiple vertices require an order
11:27 Reaching the plane can still miss the platform
11:51 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.

YamYamCoding is a Korean game-programming channel covering DirectX, Unity, Unreal Engine and computer graphics.
